def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Adapted square-root power-law model for log10(|ID|/A)."""
    k = parameters[0]
    const1 = parameters[1]
    const2 = parameters[2]
    
    gate_volt = np.power(gate_voltage_abs, const1)
    drain_volt = np.power(drain_voltage_abs, const2)
    
    return 10 * np.log10(const1 * k *(gate_volt) * (drain_volt - const2 * k * (gate_volt)**(const1/const2)))
